meta.title: Business management and career profiles in Medellín
meta.description: Operanta supports SMEs and professionals through change: processes, innovation and talent with measurable results. Medellín, Colombia.

hero.title: Business management and career profiles in Medellín
hero.lead: Operanta supports SMEs and professionals through moments of change: SMEs, to improve their processes and innovate in their business; professionals, to take the next step in their careers.

problem.title: An SME grows through two things at once

people.title: People
people.body: Teams without clear roles, high turnover and knowledge that walks out the door with whoever quits.

process.title: Processes
process.body: Reactive operations, no indicators, rework and costs nobody measures.

gap.title: The gap
gap.body: Almost no consultant works both fronts. Either operations get organized or people get trained, rarely both.
